files.engine.py: Pure directional geometry and QA construction; reuses current Layout, full_strip and numerical registration implementation.
files.cli.py: Opt-in prepare/save/assemble adapter; never invokes any image API or CLI generation.
files.verify.py: Synthetic coordinate, registration, finite-return and full4096 QA validation; produces only JSON test evidence.
files.test-evidence.json: Actual test result and source hashes; not a visual acceptance report.

neighborHashes: Every supplied neighbor key requires its exact sibling <key>Sha256; sources must be actual opaque4096 images. Missing diagonal remains unknown. Extra/opposite side inputs are rejected so they cannot be silently ignored.
physicalFrame: All guide/target images shown to AI retain their original physical game orientation and pRC global coordinates. No AI input is rotated or mirrored. Only numeric registration arrays are reflected internally to reuse the existing bounded NW algorithm; result fields return to physical coordinates with proper vector signs.
exampleCommandsNotExecuted: Read native/p14.call.json, actually view edit-target + guide + approved style, then call builtin image_gen with those exact prepared arguments.
Repeat each dependency-ready physical patch in the selected wavefront; do not pre-generate against absent predecessors.

outputContract.qaBreakdown: 6 internal seams +6 directional finite returns +9 native junctions +4 actual-neighbor or missing-neighbor perimeter sheets +2 incoming external finite returns, plus1 four-tile corner when all three neighboring tiles exist.
outputContract.reverseReturnNames: internal-x1024-return-minus256-full.png etc; actual position=seam-256. Positive direction uses plus256 names.

immutability: Existing or in-flight prepare artifacts and existing native outputs are refused; assembly refuses existing candidate/fields/QA. Generated host sources are copied without resizing. Plan and all input hashes are checked before save; source hashes are rechecked after assembly. No delete or retry-overwrite operation is provided.
recovery: A failed prepare/generation/assembly keeps its records for review; recovery is an explicit new attempt path or reviewed cleanup under project retention rules. This tool does not silently overwrite, regenerate or delete them.
reviewBeforeFirstProductionUse: Review implementation and actual test-evidence hashes. The current r10_c14 plan has no opt-in and continues using old NW helpers.
Use the first NE pilot r10_c11 after north/east/NE sources are frozen; later use SW pilot r08_c01 at its planned traversal position.
Inspect all27/28 original-scale QA sheets and exact crop/return evidence; no algorithmic metric is a visual pass.

New QA names/count and multi-edge-assembly.json differ from the old NW workflow. Use an explicitly updated finalization/report adapter; do not run r09_c14-specific finalize_local.py on these candidates.
Record every shared edge against both final candidate hashes and all affected four-tile corners, including older seven seed edges.
